3. Platform audio: cpal 48kHz stereo f32 output stream from the reassembly queue.

STOP WHEN: cargo test -p erd-app green + decode smoke test passes (synthetic HEVC stream decodes).
TDD: write the normalization/reassembly/ABR tests first (they are ported Swift semantics — port the test vectors too).
